name: Shiodome Popuri
source:
The teacher of [url=http://vndb.org/c14783]Merumo's[/url] class. She feels the best way to teach her class of girls sex education is through a live demonstration. She threatens Sex no Onii-san with death if he won't do various sex acts with Merumo.

She often speaks to some sort of superior or organization about what's happening in her class.
